datasets.name: f01250f2
queryLines:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT MAX(d.date) AS week
  FROM fact_periodic_supply_weekly f
  JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_sk = d.date_sk
),
supply AS (
  SELECT p.product_name, d.date, f.rate_kbd
  FROM fact_periodic_supply_weekly f
  JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_sk = d.date_sk
  JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_sk = p.product_sk
  JOIN dim_area a ON f.area_sk = a.area_sk
  WHERE a.area_bk = 'NUS'
),
compared AS (
  SELECT
    s.product_name,
    l.week,
    MAX(CASE WHEN s.date = l.week THEN s.rate_kbd END) AS latest_kbd,
    MAX(CASE WHEN s.date = date_sub(l.week, 7) THEN s.rate_kbd END) AS prev_week_kbd,
    MAX(CASE WHEN s.date = date_sub(l.week, 364) THEN s.rate_kbd END) AS last_year_kbd
  FROM supply s
  CROSS JOIN latest l
  WHERE s.date IN (l.week, date_sub(l.week, 7), date_sub(l.week, 364))
  GROUP BY s.product_name, l.week
)
SELECT
  product_name,
  week,
  latest_kbd,
  prev_week_kbd,
  last_year_kbd,
  try_divide(latest_kbd - prev_week_kbd, prev_week_kbd) AS wow_pct,
  try_divide(latest_kbd - last_year_kbd, last_year_kbd) AS yoy_pct
FROM compared
ORDER BY latest_kbd DESC;

datasets.name: 1f6dc02c
queryLines:
WITH weekly AS (
  SELECT
    d.date,
    d.year,
    d.month_number,
    d.month_name,
    p.product_name,
    f.rate_kbd
  FROM fact_periodic_supply_weekly f
  JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_sk = d.date_sk
  JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_sk = p.product_sk
  JOIN dim_area a ON f.area_sk = a.area_sk
  WHERE a.area_bk = 'NUS'
    AND f.rate_kbd IS NOT NULL
),
indexed AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    rate_kbd / AVG(rate_kbd) OVER (PARTITION BY product_name, year) * 100 AS seasonal_index,
    COUNT(rate_kbd) OVER (PARTITION BY product_name, year) AS weeks_in_year
  FROM weekly
)
SELECT date, year, month_number, month_name,
       date_format(date, 'MM MMM') AS month_label,
       product_name, rate_kbd, seasonal_index
FROM indexed
WHERE weeks_in_year >= 52;

datasets.name: b0cde737
queryLines:
WITH weekly_total AS (
  SELECT
    d.date,
    d.year,
    SUM(f.rate_kbd) AS total_kbd,
    COUNT(f.rate_kbd) AS products_reported
  FROM fact_periodic_supply_weekly f
  JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_sk = d.date_sk
  JOIN dim_area a ON f.area_sk = a.area_sk
  WHERE a.area_bk = 'NUS'
  GROUP BY d.date, d.year
),
all_products AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM dim_product
  WHERE product_sk NOT BETWEEN -3 AND -1
),
complete_weeks AS (
  SELECT w.*
  FROM weekly_total w
  CROSS JOIN all_products p
  WHERE w.products_reported = p.n
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(total_kbd) AS kbd_2019
  FROM complete_weeks
  WHERE year = 2019
)
SELECT
  c.date,
  c.year,
  c.total_kbd,
  c.total_kbd / b.kbd_2019 * 100 AS pct_of_2019
FROM complete_weeks c
CROSS JOIN baseline b;

datasets.name: a49bce5e
queryLines:
WITH weekly AS (
  SELECT
    d.date,
    d.year,
    p.product_name,
    f.rate_kbd
  FROM fact_periodic_supply_weekly f
  JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_sk = d.date_sk
  JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_sk = p.product_sk
  JOIN dim_area a ON f.area_sk = a.area_sk
  WHERE a.area_bk = 'NUS'
    AND f.rate_kbd IS NOT NULL
),
all_products AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM dim_product
  WHERE product_sk NOT BETWEEN -3 AND -1
),
shares AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    rate_kbd / SUM(rate_kbd) OVER (PARTITION BY date) AS share,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY date) AS products_reported
  FROM weekly
)
SELECT s.date, s.year, s.product_name, s.rate_kbd, s.share
FROM shares s
CROSS JOIN all_products p
WHERE s.products_reported = p.n;

datasets.name: c015c51e
queryLines:
WITH prices AS (
  SELECT d.date, g.grade_name, s.price_type, a.area_bk, f.price
  FROM fact_periodic_price_weekly f
  JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_sk = d.date_sk
  JOIN dim_fuel_grade g ON f.grade_sk = g.grade_sk
  JOIN dim_status s ON f.status_sk = s.status_sk
  JOIN dim_area a ON f.area_sk = a.area_sk
  WHERE g.grade_bk IN ('REGULAR', 'ULSD')
    AND f.price IS NOT NULL
),
weekly AS (
  SELECT
    date,
    grade_name,
    AVG(CASE WHEN price_type = 'retail' AND area_bk = 'NUS' THEN price END) AS retail_usd_gal,
    AVG(CASE WHEN price_type = 'spot' THEN price END) AS spot_usd_gal
  FROM prices
  GROUP BY date, grade_name
),
changes AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    retail_usd_gal - spot_usd_gal AS spread_usd_gal,
    try_divide(
      retail_usd_gal - LAG(retail_usd_gal) OVER (PARTITION BY grade_name ORDER BY date),
      LAG(retail_usd_gal) OVER (PARTITION BY grade_name ORDER BY date)
    ) AS weekly_change
  FROM weekly
  WHERE retail_usd_gal IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  *,
  STDDEV(weekly_change) OVER (
    PARTITION BY grade_name ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 12 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS volatility_13w
FROM changes;

datasets.name: 3210a433
queryLines:
WITH supply AS (
  SELECT d.date, p.product_name, p.representative_grade_bk, f.rate_kbd
  FROM fact_periodic_supply_weekly f
  JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_sk = d.date_sk
  JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_sk = p.product_sk
  JOIN dim_area a ON f.area_sk = a.area_sk
  WHERE a.area_bk = 'NUS'
    AND p.representative_grade_bk IS NOT NULL
    AND f.rate_kbd IS NOT NULL
),
retail AS (
  SELECT d.date, g.grade_bk, f.price
  FROM fact_periodic_price_weekly f
  JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_sk = d.date_sk
  JOIN dim_fuel_grade g ON f.grade_sk = g.grade_sk
  JOIN dim_status s ON f.status_sk = s.status_sk
  JOIN dim_area a ON f.area_sk = a.area_sk
  WHERE s.price_type = 'retail'
    AND a.area_bk = 'NUS'
    AND f.price IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  s.date,
  s.product_name,
  s.rate_kbd,
  r.price AS retail_usd_gal,
  s.rate_kbd * 1000 * 42 * 7 * r.price / 1e9 AS spend_bn_usd
FROM supply s
JOIN retail r
  ON r.date = s.date
 AND r.grade_bk = s.representative_grade_bk;

datasets.name: 4317619b
queryLines:
WITH supply AS (
  SELECT d.date, p.representative_grade_bk, f.rate_kbd
  FROM fact_periodic_supply_weekly f
  JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_sk = d.date_sk
  JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_sk = p.product_sk
  JOIN dim_area a ON f.area_sk = a.area_sk
  WHERE a.area_bk = 'NUS'
    AND p.representative_grade_bk IS NOT NULL
    AND f.rate_kbd IS NOT NULL
),
retail AS (
  SELECT d.date, g.grade_bk, f.price
  FROM fact_periodic_price_weekly f
  JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_sk = d.date_sk
  JOIN dim_fuel_grade g ON f.grade_sk = g.grade_sk
  JOIN dim_status s ON f.status_sk = s.status_sk
  JOIN dim_area a ON f.area_sk = a.area_sk
  WHERE s.price_type = 'retail'
    AND a.area_bk = 'NUS'
    AND f.price IS NOT NULL
),
spend AS (
  SELECT s.date, s.representative_grade_bk AS grade_bk, s.rate_kbd * 1000 * 42 * 7 * r.price AS spend_usd
  FROM supply s
  JOIN retail r ON r.date = s.date AND r.grade_bk = s.representative_grade_bk
),
latest AS (
  SELECT MAX(date) AS week FROM spend
)
SELECT
  l.week,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.grade_bk = 'GASOLINE' THEN s.spend_usd END) AS gasoline_usd,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.grade_bk = 'ULSD' THEN s.spend_usd END) AS diesel_usd,
  SUM(s.spend_usd) AS total_usd
FROM spend s
JOIN latest l ON s.date = l.week
GROUP BY l.week;

WITH retail AS (
  SELECT
    d.date,
    g.grade_bk,
    g.grade_name,
    a.area_name,
    a.area_level,
    f.price
  FROM fact_periodic_price_weekly f
  JOIN dim_date d       ON f.date_sk  = d.date_sk
  JOIN dim_fuel_grade g ON f.grade_sk = g.grade_sk
  JOIN dim_area a       ON f.area_sk  = a.area_sk
  WHERE f.hub_sk = -2
    AND g.grade_bk IN ('REGULAR', 'ULSD')
    AND a.area_level IN ('country', 'region')
)
SELECT
  r.date,
  r.grade_name,
  r.area_name                         AS region,
  r.price                             AS region_price,
  u.price                             AS us_price,
  r.price - u.price                   AS gap,
  try_divide(r.price - u.price, u.price) AS gap_pct
FROM retail r
JOIN retail u
  ON  u.date        = r.date
  AND u.grade_bk    = r.grade_bk
  AND u.area_level  = 'country'
WHERE r.area_level = 'region';

datasets.name: 95a174f0
queryLines:
WITH retail AS (
  SELECT d.date, g.grade_bk, g.grade_name, a.area_name, a.area_level, f.price
  FROM fact_periodic_price_weekly f
  JOIN dim_date d       ON f.date_sk  = d.date_sk
  JOIN dim_fuel_grade g ON f.grade_sk = g.grade_sk
  JOIN dim_area a       ON f.area_sk  = a.area_sk
  WHERE f.hub_sk = -2
    AND g.grade_bk IN ('REGULAR', 'ULSD')
    AND a.area_level IN ('country', 'region')
)
SELECT
  r.date                  AS week,
  r.grade_name,
  r.area_name             AS region,
  r.price - u.price       AS gap
FROM retail r
JOIN retail u
  ON  u.date = r.date
  AND u.grade_bk = r.grade_bk
  AND u.area_level = 'country'
WHERE r.area_level = 'region'
  AND r.date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM retail);

datasets.name: 4d1b41d4
queryLines:
SELECT
  date_trunc('WEEK', d.date) AS week,
  a.region_name             AS region,
  COUNT(*)                  AS tanker_arrivals
FROM fact_accumulating_port_call f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.entered_date_sk = d.date_sk
JOIN dim_area a ON f.area_sk = a.area_sk
JOIN dim_port p ON f.port_sk = p.port_sk
WHERE a.area_level IN ('region', 'subregion')
 AND p.terminal_type <> 'anchorage'
GROUP BY date_trunc('WEEK', d.date), a.region_name;
